# cato_socket_bypass_rule (Resource)

Manages a rule in the Cato socket bypass policy. Underlying GraphQL is marked @beta; behavior and fields may change.

## Example Usage

  required_providers {
    cato = { source = "catonetworks/cato" }
  }
}

  type = string
  sensitive = true
  description = "API token supplied through TF_VAR_token."
}

variable "account_id" {
  type = string
  description = "Cato account ID supplied through TF_VAR_account_id."
}

  token = var.token
  account_id = var.account_id
